gaps.gap: Sec. 911 foreign earned income exclusion missing
gaps.fix: Add foreignEarnedIncomeExclusion (capped by sec. 911(b)(2)(D) annual limit, prorated by qualifying days) with sec. 911(f) stacking: tax = tax(TI + excluded) - tax(excluded); split wages by US/foreign workdays.

gaps.gap: Sec. 6651(g)(2) sfrTax not in this build
gaps.fix: Add Case.sfrTax used as 'amount shown' for sec. 6651(a)(2) (and the redetermined tax when the court says so), plus an as-of date for failure-to-pay months. Without it, FTP on an SFR is always 0.
Required annual payment = lesser of 90% current / 100% prior-year tax (prior only if return filed), 4 installments, underpayment-rate tables; at least an applies flag.
Expected items failureToFileApplies / failureToPayApplies / estimatedTaxApplies so yes/no holdings without amounts (Rule 155) can be checked.

Per-activity records (gross receipts, COGS, expenses; rent with rented-months/ownership fraction routing remainder to itemized sec. 163(h)/164 or sec. 262); sec. 280A residence test (personal use > max(14 days, 10% fair-rental days), below-market family rental = personal use) barring deductions.
Activity with gross income/expenses, deductions capped at gross income, court-set forProfit flag.
Distribution kind (withdrawal|loanOffset|deemedLoan) and rolledOverWithinDays to decide includibility instead of taking amount as given.

gaps.gap: Sec. 72(e) lapse of life policy with loan
gaps.fix: Insurance-contract item: income = cash value applied to loan minus investment in contract.

gaps.gap: Sec. 6662/6664 underpayment base with unclaimed withholding
gaps.fix: asFiled.withholding separate from corrected payments; underpayment = deficiency - withholding not claimed on return (verified 20% x (38,213 - 14,229) = 4,797).
Limit to unreimbursed medical expenses paid in the distribution year above 7.5% AGI floor.

notes: Court states no final deficiency in any case except tcsumm-2021-6 (39,649 sustained; not computable: status/other income unstated). Notice deficiencies reproduced exactly for tcsumm-2022-10 (28,932) and tcsumm-2023-13 (38,213). tcsumm-2022-10 'mismatch' items are framework gaps (sec. 911(f) stacking, sfrTax), not encoding errors.
